profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Visa | Test Automation & Quality Engineering | CI/CD | Developer Productivity | AI-Assisted Development
profile.summary: I’m a Software Engineer with experience in test automation, quality engineering, CI/CD, developer productivity, and enterprise release validation across web, Android, and iOS applications. My work includes developing and improving automated test coverage, API and integration testing, building and maintaining Jenkins workflows, contributing to internal developer tools, debugging complex application and automation issues, and supporting software releases across cross-functional engineering teams. I work with technologies including Java, Python, JavaScript, SQL, Selenium, Appium, Playwright, TestNG, Maven, Postman, Jenkins, Git/GitHub, and generative and agentic AI tools for development, testing, debugging, and engineering productivity. I also bring experience in technical and product support, team leadership, and web development, along with a background in fine art that brings a creative perspective to technical problem-solving.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Improved automated test reliability across enterprise web and mobile applications by diagnosing script, test-data, environment, API, server, and downstream-service failures, increasing pass rates by ~20% and reducing release blockers. 

• Developed and maintained automated test coverage across web, Android, and iOS using Java, TestNG/Maven, Selenium, Appium, and Playwright, supporting smoke, regression, E2E, integration, feature, and application-specific testing through Jenkins CI/CD. 

• Performed API and integration testing using Postman and SQL to validate data and troubleshoot API, database, server, environment, and downstream-service behavior across complex workflows. 

• Implemented automated forward-merge workflows across 5 repositories using Jenkins, propagating approved fixes through release branches and reducing manual release-management effort. 

• Expanded an internal developer self-service validation portal to support 3 additional web/mobile applications, implementing UI configuration, Jenkins/webhook integrations, service-account authentication, execution status, debugging, and E2E validation. 

• Supported quality and release readiness across 20+ major releases and 10–15 patches, including rollbacks, ad hoc validations, and critical release events across web, mobile, backend, and SDK workflows. 

• Identified, investigated, and supported remediation/retesting of 100+ defects across web, mobile, API, database, automation, and release workflows. 

• Maintained hundreds of test cases and automated ~20 additional scenarios, improving coverage, test data, locators, maintainability, and CI/CD reliability. 

• Managed builds through Jenkins/Artifactory and partnered with Development, QA, Product, GIS, and Cybersecurity on test data, release validation, and DAST/SSDLC activities. 

• Applied GenAI and AI-assisted development tools for code analysis, debugging, technical research, documentation, test development, and engineering process improvement.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Progressed from structured software engineering training into hands-on web, mobile, and backend testing, automation, release certification, defect investigation, and cross-team engineering support.

• Executed and analyzed Android/iOS automation using Jenkins, Appium, Sauce Labs, Xcode, IntelliJ, Appium Inspector, TestFlight, physical devices, and Splunk; investigated application, automation, test-data, device, node, downstream-service, and environment failures.

• Supported release certification, application builds, smoke, regression, and E2E testing, DAST/SSDLC findings, defect tracking and retesting, and detailed U.S.-to-APAC engineering handoffs.

positions.title: QA Research Interviewer
positions.description: • Conducted structured customer-feedback interviews for community banks and credit unions, capturing data used to support customer-experience, loyalty, retention, quality, and sales-opportunity analysis.
positions.insights: Skills: Customer Service · Research Skills · Analytical Skills · Customer Service Representatives · Data Entry · Data Analysis

positions.title: Product & Application Support Analyst
positions.description:
• Promoted from Member Services into a technical product/application support role, investigating and documenting Jira incidents involving platform defects, UI/data discrepancies, enrollment and employer-group data flows, CRM workflows, and member-facing web resources.

• Supported high-priority incident and defect triage, troubleshooting issues across Salesforce, Azure data storage, Jira, and related systems; escalated findings to engineering and followed issues through resolution.

• Performed recurring system and data audits to identify discrepancies and trends and created SOPs, training materials, troubleshooting guides, and system/process documentation.

positions.title: Member Services Specialist
positions.description: • Provided member support across chat, email, and phone while managing account updates, membership administration, issue investigation, and resolution across internal platforms and CRM workflows.

positions.title: Senior Advisor – Warranty Administrator
positions.description: • Handled Tier 2 escalations and investigated complex warranty, repair, reimbursement, repurchase/trade, and safety-recall cases using CRM-based case management while coordinating resolutions across internal teams and dealerships.
